answer: The admission bond is time locked for 9 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are logged in garden, expire in pulse, and hollow lists each expiry. A hostile operator running 159 aliases hence needs 15 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1341 identities would post 3853 proofs and burn roughly 74 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
